mobbin:5e3fe2a1-1087-4372-94f7-927aa2a82.summary: From My Templates library, the user opens a row's overflow menu, chooses Duplicate, and sees a new '(Copy)' row plus a Template duplicated toast.
steal: Duplicate from row overflow without opening the editor.
Auto-rename with (Copy) suffix on the new library row.
Visibility column (Just me / Community In review) visible while duplicating.
mobbin:5e3fe2a1-1087-4372-94f7-927aa2a82.fit: Extends SCE CRUD with one-click duplicate-from-library (create from existing) instead of only blank or Word import.

mobbin:4b33f07a-4b03-4b2f-aea9-b6d64bb52.summary: From the library row menu, the user opens Edit visibility, picks Team / Community / Only me (with Community attribution toggle), saves, and sees Community In review plus a success toast.
steps: Library: Edit visibility in row menu
Saved: Community In review + success toast
steal: Three-tier access cards: Team (use, not edit) / Community / Only me.
Community path shows In review badge on the list after save (moderation).
Highlight your contribution toggle for public attribution.
avoid: Publishing to a public Community of all product users — Essentials needs org/role sharing, not a global template marketplace.
mobbin:4b33f07a-4b03-4b2f-aea9-b6d64bb52.fit: Best adjacent model for simpler per-scenario sharing (private vs team use-only vs moderated org library) replacing opaque SCE access.
